$comment: Database contract enforced by scripts/ci/verify-migrations.mjs before every deploy.
The application is deployed independently of the database. Shipping code that
assumes a table or RPC function which was never created does not raise an error
- PostgREST answers 200 with an empty result, the UI renders blank, and the
failure is silent. This file is the machine-readable list of what the code
REQUIRES to be present, so CI can refuse to deploy against a database that
Add an entry here in the SAME commit that adds code depending on it.
Removing an entry is a deliberate act: the code must stop depending on it first.
required - deploy is BLOCKED when missing. Core to serving requests.
optional - reported as a warning. Feature degrades, site still serves.

database_candidate.note: Core candidate records. Without it the admin board is empty.

master_database_candidate.note: 169-column master record; backs lookup by WhatsApp number.

database_asj_kontak.note: Public contact form inbox (contexts/contact/repository.ts reads and writes it). Created by 014_contact_messages.sql. Entry added 2026-10-12: the table was in production code and in migration 014 but NOT in this contract, so a deploy against an unmigrated database would have failed silently - the contact form would answer 200 and store nothing.

job_database.note: Job postings; the public board renders from this.

sys_config.note: Runtime configuration; loadPublicBase() reads it on every page.

fcm_tokens.note: Push notification tokens. Absent = notifications silently skip.

dependency_calls.note: Observability log of outbound calls (kernel/log.ts). Absent = no call telemetry.

idempotency_keys.note: Idempotency ledger. Absent = duplicate submissions are not suppressed.

claim_next_job.note: B5 fix. Atomic FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim. Without it two concurrent workers can run the same job - duplicated WhatsApp sends and doubled AI spend.

rate_limit_check.note: B6 fix. Atomic increment. Without it the read-modify-write race in rate-limit.ts lets the limit be bypassed under concurrency - this guards login and OTP.

rate_limit_fail.note: B6 fix. Atomic failure counter with lockout.

reclaim_stuck_jobs.note: Reaps jobs orphaned by a crashed worker. Absent = jobs can hang in 'running' forever.

master_light.note: Light master biodata read whose SQL casts ai_data_json::jsonb. Without it the PostgREST fallback still answers, but the four ai_* identity fields come back as 200 + null - the exact silent failure this function was added for (ai_data_json is text; measured 2026-10-20: 56 of 234 rows carry identitas.gender/umur). Deliberately NOT granted to anon: RLS master_own_wa already returns 0 rows for anon and the runtime calls it with the service key.
